_comment: CDSS models. code = the id used in unit keys (P051_gpt) and in the response sheets (Model column). name = ModelName column (analysis only). aliases = every spelling of the model in the source documents (CA output headers such as 'GPT 6.1 Sol P011', GC report titles such as '# E11_P051 · OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol 채점·감사 검증 자료'); matching ignores case, spaces, hyphens and underscores. Model codes and names are NEVER shown to evaluators.
